reference_flow_sign_review.reason: Reviewed cut-off hot-rolled 18/8 stainless material proxy. Source markets supply the inspected hot-rolled RER/RoW producers; each producer uses one kg of 18/8 stock and one kg of hot-rolling service. UVEK's RER material includes 0.63 kg converter stock, 0.37 kg electric stock and one kg of Hot rolling, steel per kg product. This is the full hot-rolled material, not the former Sheet rolling, chromium steel cold-rolling service, whose 0.0516 kg stock input covers rolling losses. Preserve incoming signed kg with factor +1; no separate rolling input is added. The RER average stock replaces source GLO/RoW supply, freight, production and technology mixes; geographic, vintage and background differences remain, and equal LCIA scores are not established. Preserve caller uncertainty, formulas, foreground suppliers and separate emissions. No treatment, recovery credit, omission, allocation reconstruction or inverse is inferred. Cross-system-model conversion remains unsupported; the existing reverse material rule is checked independently.
